alternatives.decision: Rejected: thinner, fragmented silhouette at 48px than built-in lightning master.

versions: Unity 6000.3.21f1. Comfy catalog and actual node schemas archived; cloud package/core version not exposed. API model identifiers in each submitted graph.

cost.limitations: Account-window spend is not task total. GPU finishing/failure costs are not itemized by job in retrieved billing. Latest 18:06Z cloud finish lies beyond report cutoff. Built-in imagegen cost unavailable; no unsupported free/zero claim.

workflowPolicy: Actual requests include all overrides and are saved with submissions. Each adopted Comfy workflow has editable server-exported UI graph and cloud save receipt; local UI conversions also retained where used.
